title: Size-Specialized Memory Allocation
body: Go 1.27 improves performance of small allocations using size-specialized allocation functions.

title: Goroutine Leak Profiles
body: Go 1.27 includes new goroutine leak profiles.

title: Generic Methods
body: Go 1.27 adds generic methods—a highly desired language feature.

title: Go 1.27 is released
body: Go 1.27 adds generic methods, encoding/json/v2 package, uuid package, faster memory allocation, goroutine leak profiles, and more.

title: Introducing the pkg.go.dev API
body: Introducing the new programmatic API for pkg.go.dev, allowing developers to fetch package and module data directly.

title: Type Construction and Cycle Detection
body: Go 1.26 simplifies type construction and enhances cycle detection for certain kinds of recursive types.

title: //go:fix inline and the source-level inliner
body: How Go 1.26's source-level inliner works, and how it can help you with self-service API migrations.

title: Allocating on the Stack
body: A description of some of the recent changes to do allocations on the stack instead of the heap.

title: Using go fix to modernize Go code
body: Go 1.26 includes a new implementation of go fix that can help you use more modern features of Go.

title: Go 1.26 is released
body: Go 1.26 adds a new garbage collector, cgo overhead reduction, experimental simd/archsimd package, experimental runtime/secret package, and more.
